claims.statement: Six work intervals and five intervening recoveries were reconstructed; no planned work interval is missing.
Work intervals 1–3 averaged 20.02, 20.02, and 19.97 SPM, respectively, within the planned 19–21 SPM range.
Work intervals 4 and 6 averaged 22.99 and 22.97 SPM, within the planned 22–24 SPM range; interval 5 averaged 19.99 SPM and was outside that range.
Each of the five reconstructed recoveries lasted 240 s, within the planned 180–300 s range.
